description: Java source code for an Android widget that displays the 'Word of the Day' from Wiktionary, including background service for API querying and widget update logic.

classes.name: WordWidget
classes.description: Main widget provider class that manages widget updates.

classes.name: WordWidget.UpdateService
classes.description: Background service that fetches the 'Word of the Day' and updates the widget.

methods.name: onUpdate
methods.description: Triggers widget update by starting the UpdateService.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Handles service start, builds and pushes widget update.

methods.name: onBind
methods.description: Returns null as binding is not used.

methods.name: buildUpdate
methods.description: Fetches the 'Word of the Day' content and constructs RemoteViews for widget display.
